summary: PGIM Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K on April 28, 2026, reporting regular monthly distributions for Class S, D, and I shares declared on April 27, 2026, payable on or about May 27, 2026 to holders of record April 30, 2026. It also disclosed net asset values per share and aggregate NAV of $266.7 million as of March 31, 2026, and provided an update on its continuous public and private offerings of shares. This filing is a routine periodic disclosure of distributions and NAV, not a special situation category event.
